status: frozen before downloading any analysis-grade event or calibration product
purpose: Acquire matched, source-only Chandra event and calibration products for Bullet Cluster and Abell 2146 shock-front geometry and thermodynamic uncertainty reconstruction without opening lensing targets.
analysis_tier: matched published shock-depth tier: the ten-observation Bullet data and the ten-observation 418 ks Abell 2146 data used in the published shock analyses

deferred_robustness_upgrade.reason: The 2.31 Ms data will be added only after the matched-depth pipeline is verified, so one cluster does not receive a hidden data-quality advantage during source definition.

exclusions: lensing coordinates, lens models, and inferred halo products
the additional Abell 2146 2018-2019 observations at this matched-depth stage
claim_boundary: All downloaded products are detector events or calibration and observation metadata; no lensing target is opened.
Level-1 events and calibration ancillaries are retained for reprocessing with a declared current CALDB.
The archived Level-2 event is retained only as a reproducibility control.
Successful acquisition does not imply that a valid shock front, temperature map, assembly clock, or causal Sigma source has been constructed.
The missing local CIAO/CALDB runtime must be installed and frozen before reduction.
